name: Bali Villa Hub
description: Directory comparing 3,000+ Bali villa rentals from 100+ verified agencies, agents and owners — monthly and yearly long-term rentals with direct contact and $0 booking fees (company-stated). Homepage also shows "List Property", "Relocation packages" and "Services" (seen on homepage). Founded Jun 2025, registered in Ireland. 86 active subscriptions — the revenue model isn't spelled out publicly; the subscription count suggests paid listings by agencies/owners (my inference, not stated).

mentions.evidence: MRR $5,139 · 86 active subscriptions Last 30 days $7,441 (+27.1%) · last 3 months $18,716 · last 6 months $30,775 Last 12 months $49,622 · all-time $50,431 Monthly: $2,088 (Nov 2025) → $3,248 (Mar) → $4,979 (Jul) → $6,473 (Sep 2026); Oct MTD $4,648. No cliff. Revenue synced 18 October 2026 ~04:05 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: Copy the pattern for a city where long-term rentals still live in Facebook groups (expat Warsaw/Kraków, Lisbon, Tbilisi, Da Nang). Free to browse, agencies pay monthly to list.

whyItPrints: "Tired of searching through Facebook groups?" — a directory that replaces a messy Facebook-group market. Classic boring marketplace-lite: listings in, leads out, recurring fees from the supply side. Twelve months of steady growth.
